text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your track. It was
incredible. I'll handle the mixing myself
and contact you again
when the song's
complete."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I got this DM after I sent over the
backing track I made, but I haven't
heard anything since. Maybe they forgot
or they're struggling with it. Or maybe 
they gave up...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, it's no good. I can't help thinking
about it. That track could've been
better. If I'd used live
instruments,
maybe the drop would've—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur! Are you free on your next day
off?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you are, fancy going to a classical
concert? It's an Irish orchestra coming to
Japan, and I was invited to attend. I was
wondering if you'd like to
join me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(An orchestral performance, huh? Can't
think of a
better way to clear my head.
But...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why're you inviting me to go? There's
gotta be
bigger classical music fans out
there besides me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That's a fair question.
I actually get a lot of
opportunities to listen to classical,
and many of my memories revolve
around it, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Never mind, I'll go. I was leaning towards
saying
yes from the start anyway. I don't
need to hear
your life story, so save it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! ♪ We can have some tea
afterward as
well!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(So, the concert itself was decent,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the first violinist had adjusted the
timbre of
their instrument with you in
mind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since long ago, they've always
added a playful edge to their
performance when they know I'm in
attendance. It's fascinating how 
personality comes through someone's
music. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You should try listening to the Emperor
play sometime. She follows every
notation on the sheet music to a tee. It's
so textbook standard, she'll put you
right to sleep.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
She must have a full understanding of the
composer's intent, then! I bet your
way of playing is charming in its own
right. I'd love to hear you two perform a
duet! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (This awkward silence is killing me.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Rudolf's here to deepen her
understanding of other countries, and
Sirius wanted to see something new.
Ugh, it's a nightmare having these two
together.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I should've left before Fine opened her
mouth. I bet they're here because
they're sticklers for etiquette and
couldn't turn down her "royal highness's"
invitation.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So, Air Shakur, what was your favorite
part of
today's performance?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh, don't drag me into this. Damn model
student, being mindful of
everyone... This whole
thing's for show
anyway, so I'll just say whatever.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Wait. How come it's on me to play
along with
them? They won't understand
my answer either
way, so...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The final motif of the fourth movement. I
liked
how the violins crescendoed to the
verge of being
pure noise.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But right before they reached their
exponential peak, they worked the room
reverb into the equation and kept things
in check. They really had their numbers
down.

text_block_list.name: Sirius & Fine
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I concur. I imagine the conductor
incorporated a bevy of accents in order
to express how every
moment in that
movement felt like an eternity.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What? No way. You got it backwards.
They were definitely emphasizing how
that was the main movement and were
trying to give the composition a new
interpretation.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the violins was so sweet and
beautiful. I was quite impressed by
how hard they
worked to keep
everything in harmony!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, yeah... Music's subjective. Guess it
makes
sense their opinions would be so
split.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(This kind of disagreement would never
arise in mathematical formulas with fixed
answers. Still, music lends itself to
multiple interpretations. I don't permit
myself that kind of ambiguity.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If the alternative's regretting I
didn't do more, I'd
rather eliminate uncertain
factors where possible and provide
ample proof for my answer.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While strolling beside the river...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Fine, you know any other people who
play violin?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And don't go naming any national
talents. I want
someone who plays for
fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My, what could you possibly be
plotting? Well,
my going rate's one bowl
of ramen for every note
I play. ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Those terms are ridiculous. And I don't
want to
hear you play anyway.
